name: manim-obsidian-plugin
description: Render manim code blocks as animations, offline.

scripts.fmt: uvx ruff@0.12.7 check --fix --exit-zero --quiet . && uvx ruff@0.12.7 format . && biome check --write .
scripts.lint: biome check . && uvx ruff@0.12.7 check . && uvx ruff@0.12.7 format --check .
scripts.test: for f in tests/*.test.ts; do node "$f" || exit 1; done
scripts.check: pnpm lint && pnpm typecheck && pnpm test && pnpm build
scripts.vault-install: pnpm build && sh -c '[ -n "$1" ] || { echo "usage: pnpm $0 <vault path>"; exit 1; } && mkdir -p "$1/.obsidian/plugins/manim" && cp main.js manifest.json styles.css "$1/.obsidian/plugins/manim/" && echo "Installed. Enable Manim under Settings -> Community plugins (or reload it)."' vault-install
scripts.vault-link: pnpm build && sh -c '[ -n "$1" ] || { echo "usage: pnpm $0 <vault path>"; exit 1; } && mkdir -p "$1/.obsidian/plugins/manim" && for f in main.js manifest.json styles.css; do ln -sf "$PWD/$f" "$1/.obsidian/plugins/manim/$f"; done' vault-link
scripts.demo-cards: manim render -qp --progress_bar none -v WARNING --media_dir demo/out/media -a demo/cards.py
scripts.demo-obsidian: pnpm vault-link demo/vault && mkdir -p /tmp/obsidian-demo-profile && printf '{"vaults":{"manimdemo":{"path":"%s","ts":0,"open":true}},"updateDisabled":true}' "$PWD/demo/vault" > /tmp/obsidian-demo-profile/obsidian.json && open -n -a Obsidian --args --user-data-dir=/tmp/obsidian-demo-profile --remote-debugging-port=9334 --disable-renderer-backgrounding --disable-backgrounding-occluded-windows --disable-background-timer-throttling
scripts.version: node version-bump.mjs && git add manifest.json versions.json

author: MdSadiqMd
